title: Old Drift Lodge
summary: Tented suites beside the Zambezi, with safari activities built into the stay.
bestFor: A stay centred on the river and bush
body: Old Drift is a river-based safari lodge within Zambezi National Park. Its accommodation includes standard, family and star suites, giving couples and families different ways to stay under canvas.

The lodge lists game drives, river safaris and a Falls tour among its inclusive activities. Compare the full package rather than the room alone: the precise inclusions, scheduled activities and excluded charges should be set out in your quotation.
highlights: Standard, family and star suite categories
Safari activities listed by the lodge

planning.label: Choose your suite
planning.text: Ask which configuration suits your party and whether the star suite is available on your dates.

planning.label: Rate basis
planning.text: Request a breakdown of meals, drinks, transfers, activities and conservation or entry charges.

planning.label: Plan your time
planning.text: Leave space for lodge activities instead of filling every day with outside excursions.

title: Victoria Falls Safari Lodge
summary: A lodge overlooking a wildlife waterhole, with restaurants and town connections.
alt: Victoria Falls Safari Lodge · official property photograph
body: This lodge is built around its bush setting and waterhole views. Room choice matters: standard rooms, waterhole-facing rooms and suites do not offer the same outlook or layout.

The property lists a swimming pool, restaurants, a fitness centre and a scheduled shuttle to town and the rainforest. The Boma and a spa are on the wider estate. These facilities make it worth considering for guests who want lodge surroundings while keeping access to town.

planning.label: Room selection
planning.text: Specify a waterhole-facing category if the view is a priority.

planning.label: Getting around
planning.text: Check shuttle stops and times before relying on them for activity connections.

planning.label: Your quotation
planning.text: Confirm meals, estate experiences, spa treatments and transfers separately.

sources.title: Victoria Falls Safari Collection · Lodge information

title: Palm River Hotel
summary: Riverfront rooms, a pool and spa, with a scheduled shuttle to the Falls and town.
bestFor: Hotel comfort with a river setting
alt: Palm River Hotel · official property photograph
body: Palm River combines a riverside setting with the services of a hotel. Its accommodation includes deluxe rooms and suites, with interconnecting options for families or friends travelling together.

The hotel lists a spa, swimming pool and scheduled shuttle service. Ra-Ikane cruises depart from its riverfront jetty, although a cruise should be confirmed as a separate booking unless your package expressly includes one.

planning.label: Families
planning.text: Ask which room pair or suite configuration fits your group.

planning.label: Transfers
planning.text: Confirm airport collection and the current town shuttle timetable.

planning.label: Dining
planning.text: Tell the hotel about dietary needs in advance and check your meal plan.

title: Nkosi Guest Lodge
summary: A smaller garden lodge with a pool, restaurant and family accommodation.
bestFor: A quiet base for active days out
body: Nkosi Guest Lodge belongs to the Bayete Collection and sits in a residential part of Victoria Falls. The property lists superior accommodation, family options and two accessible rooms.

A pool, restaurant and bar provide space between excursions, and the lodge publishes breakfast-inclusive rates. This is a town-area guest lodge rather than a riverfront safari camp; think about transfers when comparing it with more central accommodation.
highlights: Breakfast-inclusive rates listed by the lodge

planning.label: Accessibility
planning.text: Discuss specific access needs and reserve the appropriate room rather than assuming every room is accessible.

planning.label: Room choice
planning.text: Confirm the layout and occupancy of the family or superior room you are quoted.

planning.label: Transport
planning.text: Arrange airport and activity transfers; do not assume every attraction is walkable.

sources.title: The Bayete Collection · Nkosi Guest Lodge

title: Pioneers Lodge
summary: Garden-facing rooms, two pools and a day spa in a residential setting.
body: Pioneers is a garden lodge in a quiet residential suburb. The property describes 50 rooms, including family rooms, with air-conditioning and views over the gardens.

Its shared spaces include a terrace, restaurant, bar, two swimming pools and a day spa. It suits a stay where mornings are spent exploring and afternoons can be left open, rather than an itinerary built around in-camp safari activities.
highlights: Family rooms and a day spa

planning.label: Families
planning.text: Ask about the current family-room layout and child occupancy arrangements.

planning.label: Meal plan
planning.text: Confirm which meals are included and how early breakfast is available before excursions.

planning.label: Getting around
planning.text: Check transfers to town and the rainforest rather than relying on walking distances.

title: The Victoria Falls Hotel
summary: A long-established hotel dating to 1904, with a wide choice of rooms and suites.
body: The Victoria Falls Hotel dates to 1904. Its room collection runs from classic categories to larger suites and the separate Stables Signature Wing.

Choose a specific category rather than booking on the hotel name alone. Layout, outlook and included services can differ. This is a heritage hotel experience, distinct from staying in a tented camp within the national park.
highlights: A broad choice of rooms and suites

planning.label: Room choice
planning.text: Request the exact category, bed arrangement and outlook before confirming.

planning.label: Comparing rates
planning.text: Check breakfast and other inclusions against the category quoted.

planning.label: Special requests
planning.text: Discuss step-free access or connecting accommodation directly before booking.

alt: The Victoria Falls Hotel · official property photograph

title: Victoria Falls River Lodge
summary: Riverside tented suites with private plunge pools and a programme of game activities.
body: Victoria Falls River Lodge’s luxury tented suites sit on the Zambezi inside the national park. They combine canvas, timber and glass, with private decks and plunge pools. Family tent options provide an alternative to separate rooms.

The published tented-suite package includes meals, local beverages and a choice of scheduled game drives or river cruises. Park and conservation fees and some extras are excluded, so a fully inclusive label still needs a written breakdown.

planning.label: Select the accommodation
planning.text: Confirm that your quote is for the tented lodge, an island suite or a villa; these are different products.

planning.label: Inclusions
planning.text: Check airport transfers, activities and all mandatory levies in your quotation.

planning.label: Pacing
planning.text: Allow time to enjoy the included lodge programme and the river setting.

sources.title: Victoria Falls River Lodge · Tented suites

alt: Victoria Falls River Lodge · official property photograph

title: a’Zambezi River Lodge
summary: A riverside hotel with a pool, restaurant and a courtesy town shuttle.
body: a’Zambezi offers a hotel stay on the riverbank outside the centre of Victoria Falls. Its grounds and shared facilities are a different proposition from a small tented safari camp.

The property lists a river-view swimming pool, Amulonga restaurant and a courtesy shuttle serving town and the rainforest. It is worth comparing for travellers who want river surroundings with hotel facilities and planned excursions.

planning.label: Room outlook
planning.text: Ask whether your quoted category faces the river or the gardens.

planning.label: Transport
planning.text: Confirm the current shuttle schedule and arrange airport collection separately.

planning.label: Activities
planning.text: Check boat trips, activity transfers and meal inclusions against your booking.

alt: a’Zambezi River Lodge · official property photograph

title: Shongwe Oasis
summary: An adults-only garden retreat with a spa, infinity pool and access to the neighbouring lookout tower.
bestFor: Adults seeking pool time & a quieter stay
body: Shongwe Oasis offers an adults-only stay in tropical gardens. The property lists 19 rooms, a spa, jacuzzi, infinity pool and an in-house restaurant and bar.
Guests also have access to the neighbouring Shongwe Lookout tower. Consider it for a stay with time at the property as well as days out, and confirm the current age policy before booking for a group.
highlights: Access to the neighbouring lookout tower

planning.label: Guest policy
planning.text: Confirm the minimum guest age and any group booking requirements.

planning.label: Room selection
planning.text: Ask about the room layout and outdoor bathroom arrangements.

planning.label: Your package
planning.text: Check meals, treatments and airport or activity transfers separately.

title: Waterfalls Lodge
summary: Wild Horizons accommodation with garden rooms, shared facilities and optional activity packages.
bestFor: A lodge base for outings around town
body: Waterfalls Lodge is part of the Wild Horizons accommodation collection in Victoria Falls. Its garden setting and waterfall-inspired shared spaces provide a base for exploring the town and nearby attractions.

The lodge offers dining on site and describes optional packages linking accommodation with transfers and activities. Compare those packages with the room-only or breakfast-based quotation rather than assuming every activity is included.

planning.label: Room arrangement
planning.text: Confirm bed configuration, family occupancy and any specific access needs.

planning.label: Package details
planning.text: Ask which meals, transfers and activities are included in the exact rate quoted.

planning.label: Dining
planning.text: Check whether any Lookout Café dining arrangement requires a separate reservation.

title: Kasambabezi Lodge
summary: A garden property with king/twin room options, a pool, restaurant and lookout tower.
body: Kasambabezi lists deluxe rooms that can be arranged as king or twin accommodation, as well as suites with private gardens. Check the specific category rather than relying on a general room description.

The property’s facilities include a pool, restaurant, bar, lookout tower and conference space. It is a town-area lodge, so airport collection and transport to your chosen activities remain part of the planning.

planning.label: Choose your room
planning.text: Confirm garden or pool outlook, bed arrangement and any additional bedding.

planning.label: Rate basis
planning.text: Ask about breakfast, other meals and any compulsory charges.

planning.label: Transport
planning.text: Request the current airport and activity transfer arrangements.

title: Bhejane Lodge
summary: A smaller lodge with a garden, outdoor pool, bar and breakfast service.
bestFor: A straightforward base for days out
body: Bhejane Lodge describes a garden setting with an outdoor swimming pool, bar and air-conditioned rooms. The property publishes breakfast as part of its accommodation offering.

Airport transfers are offered at an additional charge, and the lodge can arrange transport to local attractions. Confirm the room category and transport costs for your dates instead of comparing room prices alone.

planning.label: Accommodation
planning.text: Confirm the room category, bed arrangement and occupancy.

planning.label: Transfers
planning.text: Ask for the current airport charge and activity collection arrangements.

planning.label: Early departures
planning.text: Check breakfast arrangements if you have an early excursion or flight.

title: Batonka Guest Lodge
summary: Garden and pool-facing rooms with private patios, dining areas and a shared pool.
bestFor: A garden base with patio space
body: Batonka Guest Lodge has 27 rooms split between pool-view and garden-view accommodation. Rooms have private patios, making the room outlook a useful part of the choice.

Shared facilities include a pool, indoor and outdoor dining areas, a lounge and a curio shop. The lodge is a town-area base rather than an inclusive safari camp, so compare your meal plan and transport needs alongside the accommodation.
highlights: Pool, dining areas and a lounge

planning.label: Room outlook
planning.text: Request the garden or pool-facing category you prefer.

planning.label: Your stay
planning.text: Confirm meals, room occupancy and any specific access requirements.

planning.label: Outings
planning.text: Check collection points and transfer arrangements for your activity bookings.
